name: 902 Batch Validator
description: Checks a 902 batch before work starts: which parts on the list have no DXF, which DXFs are empty, which IGES files are corrupt, and which parts have no print - then writes one color-coded PDF report to send back to EB.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Have the batch folder ready: the DXF and IGES files EB sent, and the 'WPDD Files' folder with the prints. Subfolders are fine.
The batch folder needs a part list: EB's own 'B#### 902 OFFLOAD TO ASA' workbook, or the pricing workbook with the PO tab. Close it in Excel before running.
how_it_works: Pick the batch folder (or the folder with its part files) when the picker opens.
The app reads the part list, then opens every DXF and IGES file it finds and checks that it really has a part in it.

EB sends each part as a DXF and an IGES. They are checked separately, and a part has an issue when either one is wrong: no DXF sent, a DXF with nothing to cut, or an IGES that was cut off or holds no part outline.
Then it reads the prints in the WPDD folder: every page of the prints PDF (the part number is read off the drawing itself) and every print image named for a part. A part with no print is an issue.
When the list says '-145M' and the files or prints say '-145' it is the same piece: matched, and noted. Nothing in the batch is moved, renamed or changed.
output: One color-coded PDF in the batch folder: '{batch} - BATCH VALIDATION REPORT.pdf'. Page 1 is the counts (target, missing, unusable, corrupt, no print, needs a look) and then EVERY part with Issue Y/N and what is wrong. The next page breaks the problems down by kind, lists the print pages that matched no part, and the files that are not on the PO.
The parts with an issue are also listed in the console so they can be copied straight into a message to EB, and a popup names them.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
